hooks.text: 棋子自动落场，玩家专注牌组、遗物和棋子协同
hooks.excerpt: Your pieces are automatically played onto the battlefield, and players will focus on matching and building unique decks and artifacts, fully exploiting the synergies between pieces.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 三枚相邻同等级棋子会自动合成更高等级
hooks.excerpt: When three same-level pieces are adjacent on the battlefield, they will automatically combine into a higher-level piece, forging an unbreakable force.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 程序生成狩猎图让路线穿过战斗、商店、附魔和事件节点
hooks.excerpt: Continuously make progress through procedurally generated hunting maps, carefully choosing routes to explore different nodes such as battles, shops, enchantments, events, and more.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
